codex-eco
Eco mode for Codex — fewer tokens per turn, with a correctness floor that is measured.

Install (CLI + desktop app)

git clone https://github.com/sup3x/codex-eco cd codex-eco && ./install.sh

Or as a Codex plugin

codex plugin marketplace add sup3x/codex-eco codex plugin add eco@codex-eco
